title: 第25章 小剑蛙祭司初战召唤剑刃蛙群第26章 双生统领级剑渊蛙
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 持刀狒狒领地外，夜玄头顶小剑蛙祭司四处晃悠，终于发现练手目标。
那是一只蹲在草丛中，正在快速进食的灰郊狼，体长半米，尾巴尖长有类似于流星锤模样的圆刺。
灰郊狼，普通级风属性妖兽，天赋高智。
天赋赐予灰郊狼高超的智商，懂得分寸。
忌惮的看了眼夜玄，进食中的灰郊狼张嘴撕咬块血淋淋的带毛兔肉，甩首丢出。
像是在说，请你吃，和气生财，莫要找事。
伸手不打笑脸狼。
夜玄转身，重新替小剑蛙祭司寻找合适对手。
没过会。
他找寻到一只合适目标。
草丛中，一只足有成年人大腿粗细的木角蟒窜出，并挡住去路，恶狠狠的紧盯夜玄。
普通级妖兽木角蟒，木属性，天赋巨力。
木角蟒这种妖兽软骨厚度密集无比，力量方面很恐怖，一旦被绞杀住，往往很难挣脱。
这只木角蟒足有八米长，境界约莫在一阶九星。
小剑蛙祭司又惊又怕，长有蹼的小手紧紧拽住夜玄头发不松。
“它是你的对手。”
夜玄伸手拽住头顶上的小剑蛙祭司，四目相对，“小家伙，让我见识见识统领级妖兽的风采。”
“湫湫…”
小剑蛙祭司目露胆怯，畏惧的摇动小脑袋瓜。
观摩中的黑姬哭笑不得。
让刚出生的幼崽去战斗？亏夜玄能做的出来。
幼兽脆弱，哪个不是好吃好喝供养，为其日后成长打基础，万一磕着碰着，到时可有的哭。
“别怕。”
“来，吃口蜜壮壮胆。”
夜玄笑眯眯的，自困妖笼内取出椰壳碗。
碗内，装有琥珀色蜂蜜。
鼻岛物产资源丰富，蜂蜜之类自是不会缺。
细嗅空气中浓郁花蜜甜香，小剑蛙祭司瞪大蓝色兽瞳，嘴角不受控制留下道晶莹口水。

Outside the territory of the knife-wielding baboons, the little sword frog priest on Ye Xuan's head wandered around, and finally found the training target.
It was a gray coyote squatting in the grass and eating quickly. It was half a meter long and had a round thorn that looked like a meteor hammer on the tip of its tail.
Gray Coyote is an ordinary level wind attribute monster with high intelligence.
Talent gives Gray Coyote a high IQ and a sense of proportion.
"Roar!"
Looking at Ye Xuan fearfully, the gray coyote who was eating opened his mouth and bit into a piece of bloody rabbit meat, then threw it away.
It seems to be saying, treat you to a meal, be friendly and make money, and don’t look for trouble.
Don't reach out to hit the smiling wolf.
Ye Xuan turned around and looked for a suitable opponent for the little sword frog priest again.
Not after a while.
He found a suitable target.
"Hiss!"
In the grass, a wood-horned python as thick as an adult's thigh sprang out and blocked the way, staring fiercely at Ye Xuan.
The ordinary-level monster, the Wood Horned Python, has wood attributes and is gifted with great strength.
The wood horned python is a monster with extremely dense cartilage and terrifying strength. Once strangled, it is often difficult to break free.
This wood-horned python is eight meters long, and its realm is about the first level of nine stars.
"Qiu..."
The little sword frog priest was frightened and frightened. His small webbed hands held Ye Xuan's hair tightly to keep it from loosening.
"Up."
"It's your opponent."
Ye Xuan stretched out his hand and grabbed the little sword frog priest above his head, and looked at each other, "Little guy, let me see the style of the commander-level monster."
"Qiuqiu..."
The little sword frog priest looked timid and shook his little head in fear.
Heiji, who was watching, couldn't laugh or cry.
Let the newborn cubs fight? It's a shame that Ye Xuan can do it.
The cubs are fragile, and they are not easy to eat, drink, and provide food to lay the foundation for their future growth. If they bump into each other, they may cry.
"Don't be afraid."
"Come, eat some honey to strengthen your courage."
Ye Xuan smiled and took out the coconut shell bowl from the trapped demon cage.
Inside the bowl, there is amber honey.
Bi Island is rich in natural resources, and there is no shortage of honey.
"Qiu?"
Smelling the rich sweet scent of nectar in the air, the little sword frog priest opened his blue eyes wide and left a trail of crystal saliva at the corner of his mouth uncontrollably.
